description: This PHP class defines a filter parameter object for searching likes on comments within the Buzz module of OrangeHRM. It extends a generic FilterParams class and specifies allowed sorting fields and a comment ID property with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnCommentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for filtering comment like search results based on comment ID and sort options within the Buzz module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params with a default sort field.

methods.name: getCommentId
methods.description: Retrieves the comment ID used for filtering.

methods.name: setCommentId
methods.description: Sets the comment ID used for filtering.
